---
title: "Hazelnut analyses"
title-tr: "Fındık analizleri"
description: "Seasons, export markets, crop size and frost, the Giresun and Ordu exchanges, and how the price forecasts scored."
description-tr: "Sezonlar, ihracat pazarları, rekolte ve don, Giresun ve Ordu borsaları ve fiyat tahminlerinin aldığı puanlar."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import i18n
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops
from hazelnut.site.i18n import t

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug / "manifest.json")

# Title and one-line summary per analysis (hazelnut copy, hazelnut.analyses.<slug> in
# site/i18n); the list and its order come from crops.yml `analyses`.
def entry(slug):
    key = f"{crop.slug}.analyses.{slug.replace('-', '_')}"
    return (t(f"{key}.title"), t(f"{key}.summary"))

ENTRIES = {slug: entry(slug) for slug in crop.analyses
           if i18n.has(f"{crop.slug}.analyses.{slug.replace('-', '_')}.title")}

stamp = ""
if manifest is not None:
    stamp = (f'<span class="live"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>'
             f'{ph.escape(ph.as_of_stamp(manifest))}</span>')
ph.raw_html(
    '<div class="dash-head"><div>'
    f'<span class="eyebrow">{ph.escape(t("analyses.index_eyebrow", crop=i18n.crop_name(crop)))}</span>'
    f'<h1>{ph.escape(t("analyses.h1"), quote=False)}</h1></div>'
    f"{stamp}</div>"
    f'<p class="lede">{ph.escape(t("analyses.lede"), quote=False)}</p>'
)
```

```{python}
ph.raw_html(ph.analyses_list_html(crop.analyses, ENTRIES))
```
